The '''Ruten Pet Show''' was an event held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruten]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was instituted by sycophants attempting to curry favor with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Bursthed]]; Bursthed had a love of exotic creatures and kept several as pets. Ostensibly an annual event, the pet show was hosted four times in eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]], with Bursthed's pets winning the first prize every time.
